copy.headline: $11B of tunnel work, one system of record
copy.subhead: The MTA standardized capital program delivery on Kahua.

plate_direction: Deep tunnel under construction beneath a rail terminal at dawn. Wet concrete, steel ribs, work lighting raking along the bore. Cool blue-grey ground with generous quiet negative space in the upper third for copy. Jobsite-real, never stock-office. No gradients, no abstract illustration.
notes: Made up for local testing. Kahua is construction project management, so an infrastructure programme is on-brand.
